**CareerPilot AI v1.1.0**: eye contact on Android, a new app icon and a calmer microphone.

**Web app:** https://careerpilot-ai-762bb.web.app
**Android:** download **`CareerPilot-AI-v1.1.0.apk`** below (works on almost every phone). Only for very old phones that refuse it: `CareerPilot-AI-v1.1.0-older-phones.apk`. Open the file on your phone and allow "Install unknown apps" when Android asks. It installs over v1.0.0 and keeps you logged in.

### New
- **Eye contact in the Android app.** The live interview now uses the phone's front camera, like the web app: an eye-contact light while you answer, a camera check screen, and eye contact in the report (content 60%, speaking 20%, presence 20%). It uses the same face model and the same calculations as the web app, and the video never leaves your phone.
- **App icon and start-up screen** with the CareerPilot logo, followed by the same loading screen as the web app.

### Fixed
- **The interview no longer keeps listening after you have finished.** Short sounds (clicks, breathing, a phone microphone boosting the room noise) no longer count as speech; the answer ends 3 seconds after you stop talking.
- **Urdu interviews:** the interviewer's voice is found on the first try after opening the page (no more "no Urdu voice" until a refresh).
- Clearer messages on the phone when the camera or microphone permission is off.

To check a download, compare it with `CareerPilot-AI-v1.1.0.sha256`.
